title: ATME Signs MOU with Intellect Bastion
content:
ATME Signs MOU with Intellect Bastion

ATME College of Engineering is happy to announce its MOU with Intellect Bastion. This Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) establishes the guidelines for collaboration between Intellect Bastion and ATME College of Engineering in regard to Patent filings and prosecution. Intellect Bastion IP Services, having their registered office at B-78, New Gupta Colony, Delhi – 110034, through its Managing Director Dr. Prachi Chopra, and ATME College of Engineering, having their registered office at 13th Kilometre, Mysuru – Kanakapura – Bengaluru Road, Mysuru – 570028, Karnataka, through its Principal, Dr. L. Basavaraj have signed the aforementioned MoU on the 21st of April, 2021.
